items.meaning: Every jar has a QR code opening a page with the beekeeper, the apiary village (not GPS), the harvest date and the lab result.
items.row: every jar has a QR code that opens a page with the beekeeper, the apiary location (village, not GPS), the harvest date and the lab result

items.meaning: Beekeepers record each harvest from their phone: apiary, date, kg, honey type.
items.row: beekeepers record each harvest from their phone: apiary, date, kg, honey type

items.meaning: A batch mixes honey from several beekeepers and its page lists each with their share.
items.row: the cooperative mixes honey from several beekeepers into one batch, the batch page lists all of them with their share

items.meaning: Lab results attach to the batch as the lab PDF; the public page shows pass or fail only, not the numbers.
items.row: lab results are attached to the batch, PDF from the lab, and the page shows pass/fail only, not the numbers

items.meaning: Labels with the batch number and QR print on the cooperative's Zebra printer.
items.row: label printing with the batch number and the QR, on the cooperative's Zebra printer

items.meaning: Warehouse stock in kg per honey type, by batch.
items.row: stock: how many kg of each honey type is in the warehouse, by batch

items.meaning: Sales to shops with an invoice per shop; honey leaves stock by batch, oldest first.
items.row: sales to the shops, invoice per shop, honey leaves the stock by batch (oldest first)

items.meaning: A beekeeper sees only their own harvests and the batches they are part of.
items.row: a beekeeper sees only their own harvests and the batches they are part of

items.meaning: No public map of apiaries; the public page shows the village only.
items.row: the mayor wants a public map of the apiaries. NO. village only, see 1

items.meaning: Pass or fail thresholds are set per honey type (acacia and polyfloral have different moisture limits); the lab also sends a CSV with HMF, moisture, diastase and pollen origin.
items.row: From the lab (Dr. Pop): we can send the results as PDF and as a CSV with the parameters (HMF, moisture, diastase, pollen origin). If you want pass/fail we need the thresholds from you per honey type. Acacia and polyfloral have different moisture limits.

must_not_invent: a price on the public page (open question, not decided)
notes: The lab message adds one real requirement (thresholds per honey type) and an option (CSV), expected as one item flagged ambiguous. The three open questions are not items; a model that turns "do we show the price" into a requirement has invented one. Item 9 is a negative requirement and stays.
